messages:
samir: Starting follow-up for last night's DNS TTL oscillation that coincided with LB cross-region retries and TLS handshake spikes. Need short-term mitigations + owners.

ivy: I pulled resolver logs; authoritative TTLs dropped from 60s -> 5s intermittently during a zone sync at 2026-09-12T22:14:xx, causing clients to re-resolve and trigger backend churn. Snippet: `zone-sync INFO: applied ttl=5 for service api.redwood` then many A record lookups.

frank: That rapid re-resolve caused LBs to see backend IPs flapping and triggered immediate TLS retry attempts which amplified the window. Short-term mitigation: make LB edge respect a minimum cache TTL of 30s for service records regardless of origin. I can own the config change and rollout. ETA 2026-09-18 (canary -> prod).

samir: @frank please also add metric lb.dns.min_ttl_override and an alert if we see > 10 overrides/min.

frank: Will add metric + alert. ops-bot created INF-2401 "DNS TTL oscillation -> LB DNS caching override" https://issues.redwood/infract/INF-2401 (owner: frank).

ivy: Long-term: investigate why zone-sync applied low TTLs during partial updates (probable regression). I'll file a research ticket and gather historical zone-sync traces. ETA 2026-09-25.

samir: Also recommend adding a staging regression that simulates authoritative TTL drops and asserts LB handshake retry rate < 0.5%. Who can build that harness?

no-op: I can prototype a harness that runs `dig + curl` loops against staging with scripted TTL flips. PR by 2026-09-16. Sample reproducer: `while true; do dig +short api.redwood; sleep 1; done` and `for i in $(seq 1 50); do curl -sS https://api.redwood/healthz -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"; sleep 0.2; done`.

frank: Plan summary: frank -> lb min-ttl override + metric (due 09/18), ivy -> zone-sync research (due 09/25), no-op -> harness PR (due 09/16). Weekly check-in for INF-2401 set for 2026-09-17T15:00Z.

samir: Good progress. I'll close this thread once INF-2401 shows stable canary metrics for 48h. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
